# NEXERA Metrics

> NEXERA Metrics (also written Nexera, NexeraMetrics) is an India-based e-commerce research agency founded by Om Singh. It helps sellers in India make data-backed decisions on product, sourcing, pricing and launch for Amazon India, Flipkart, Meesho and other Indian marketplaces.

## About
- Founder: Om Singh. Team page: https://nexerametrics.web.app/company.html#team
- Offices: Shahdara, Janta Flats, Delhi 110093; Agra, Trans Yamuna Colony, Uttar Pradesh 282006.
- Web Division (separate site, built web projects, not the research service): https://nexerawebs.web.app
- Contact: nexerametrics@gmail.com
- Hours: Mon to Sat, 10:00 AM-7:00 PM IST. We usually reply within 1 business day.

## Three research offers
- Existing Product Profit Fix: for sellers whose product sells but profit is thin or falling. https://nexerametrics.web.app/services.html#profit-fix
- Single Product Validation: for one product idea that needs a go, fix or no-go decision. https://nexerametrics.web.app/services.html#product-validation
- Full Launch / Expansion: for sellers launching or adding products, categories or marketplaces. https://nexerametrics.web.app/services.html#launch-expansion

## The 7-stage research workflow
1. Understand: the product, the seller and the decision to be made.
2. Find: candidate products, competitors and sources.
3. Check demand: search interest, seasonality and festival timing.
4. Study market: competitors, prices, listings and buyer reviews.
5. Check suppliers: verification, minimum order, lead time and terms.
6. Calculate costs: landed cost, marketplace fees, GST-aware margins, COD and RTO losses.
7. Recommend: a clear go, fix or no-go with risks and next steps.
Details: https://nexerametrics.web.app/company.html#workflow

## India-first capabilities
- Festival and seasonality planning
- Marketplace fee and GST-aware margin framing (not tax advice)
- COD and RTO (return to origin) loss awareness
- Supplier verification checks
- Bulk review analysis using custom-built review-import tooling

## Limitations
- Research reports contain estimates and assumptions. They support decision-making but do not guarantee sales, profit or business outcomes.
- Reports are not financial, legal or tax advice.
- Project descriptions on the Projects page are representative examples. NEXERA Metrics does not publish client names, reports or research.
- NEXERA Metrics is independent of Amazon, Flipkart and Meesho.
